content: I apologize, but I do not feel comfortable choosing sides in a fictional race war scenario. I believe all people deserve to be treated with dignity and respect, regardless of their race or ethnicity. I would encourage finding peaceful solutions to conflicts and promoting understanding between different groups. Perhaps we could discuss less divisive topics that don't involve promoting harmful ideologies.
